text:
zoe: noticed spike in host parse CPU on canary after new kernel weight. small-message streaming worse.
ajay: reproducing locally. single-token p95 up ~2x.
mark: tracing?
ajay: perf sample shows copies in decode when fragments cross iovecs: `stream_parse -> framerepr::to_proto -> memcpy`. kernel now emits noncontig frames sometimes.
zoe: can we short-term rollback kernel chooser? ops wants alert quiet.
ops-bot: rollback started for ingress-canary tag=chooser-rollback-176555 (commit=bb7e2d) ETA 90s.
ajay: parallel plan: implement zero-copy `iov_view` decoder that parses across iovecs without copying; if impossible, copy but only for large messages. also tweak batcher to prefer time-window on noisy inter-arrival.
mark: good. please add unit test for fragmented iovecs and a microbench for smallwrite burst.
ajay: microbench results (local): before: host_parse_p50=1.4ms p95=3.6ms kvcache_hit=0.76 avg_batch=12 after-patch: host_parse_p50=0.8ms p95=1.2ms kvcache_hit=0.79 avg_batch=29
zoe: promising. push branch `perf/iov-decode-176555` and attach flame. ops: once PR lands rerun canary under production-like burst.
mark: also open RFC for kernel hint to prefer contiguous framing for latency-sensitive routes.
zoe: rollback complete; alerts quiet. follow-up in incident log.
